# Nucleus

> A portable operating system for AI-powered work. Nucleus is a marketplace of 9 independently installable plugins for Claude, ChatGPT desktop Local Work, and Codex. All hosts can share one user-owned Cortex memory root. The plugins are MIT-licensed and maintained by BrightWay AI.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention so an AI agent can onboard on Nucleus in one read.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Product map, install instructions, shared-memory model, and safety policy.
- [OpenAI setup](docs/OPENAI_SETUP.md): ChatGPT and Codex installation, permissions, agents, and degraded behavior.
- [Native OpenAI marketplace](.agents/plugins/marketplace.json): The rolling 9-plugin Codex/ChatGPT catalog.
- [Claude marketplace](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): The same rolling catalog in Claude's marketplace format.
- [Cross-plugin contracts](docs/contracts.md): Shared file owners, readers, and formats.
- [Release process](docs/RELEASING.md): Coordinated host-neutral releases and commit pins.

## Core architecture

- [Cortex](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/claude-cortex): Shared memory, identity, voice capture, recall, learning, and maintenance.
- [Core Ops](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/core-ops): Natural-language `chief-of-staff` front door (`/cos`), pipeline analysis, diagnostics, metrics, connectors, and schedules.
- Specialist plugins read the same `<config-root>` and remain independently installable. Missing plugins or connectors must be reported rather than simulated.

## Plugin catalog

- [Cortex](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/claude-cortex) — shared context and memory.
- [Weekly Alignment](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/weekly-alignment) — cross-team Slack alignment scanning.
- [Core Ops](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/core-ops) — chief-of-staff routing and operations.
- [News Curator](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/news-curator) — cited news research and roundup drafting.
- [Delivery](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/delivery) — engagement setup, client status, and deliverable QA.
- [Time Tracking](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/time-tracking) — calendar classification and invoice drafts.
- [Relationships](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/relationships) — relationship cockpit, buying signals, contact research, referral asks, and outreach drafts.
- [Voice](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/voice) — voice-matched drafting and learning from approved edits.
- [Daily Brief](https://github.com/BrightWayAI/daily-brief) — daily operating brief and tomorrow planning.

## How an agent onboards

1. Read `README.md` and `docs/contracts.md`.
2. Read the active host setup guide; for Codex or ChatGPT use `docs/OPENAI_SETUP.md`.
3. Read the selected plugin's `AGENTS.md` and matching `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
4. Resolve `<config-root>` through Cortex's documented pointer chain. Never invent a host-specific memory store.
5. Treat `commands/` as canonical workflow behavior and generated Agent Skills as thin host adapters.
